title: How Portion Creep Quietly Eats Your Margin

scenes.say: A slightly bigger scoop, every plate. That's ten thousand eight hundred dollars a year.
Say your chicken bowl sells for fourteen dollars. The recipe says four ounces of chicken. A heavy hand makes it five. That extra ounce costs a quarter.
A quarter sounds like nothing. Times a hundred twenty bowls a day, all year, it's ten thousand eight hundred dollars.

scenes.speaker: Dev
scenes.say: Nobody ever showed me the recipe. I just scoop until it looks right.

props.name: Dev
props.quote: I just scoop until it *looks right*.

scenes.say: So: weigh one plate every shift. Use portion scoops, not guesswork. And pin a photo of each dish at the pass.

props.title: Stop the creep
steps: A photo of each dish at the pass
